status: DRAFT: semantic baseline qualification completed; evaluator preparation and hardware-arithmetic qualification pending; no participant comparison trials executed
research_question: Does an explicit LLM2RTL contract and staged verification procedure improve existing-design modification completion and reduce user intervention?

baseline.model_tensor_execution: PL only; PS command/address/control/transport and test observation
baseline.snapshot_status: Runnable content-verified baseline created on backup storage; verify manifest before each independent copy

accuracy.proposal_status: thresholds are proposed in advance; qualification required, not a claim of current full-model PASS
accuracy.normalized_rmse_definition: sqrt(mean((actual-reference)^2)) / max(sqrt(mean(reference^2)), 1e-6), calculated separately per tensor; near-zero reference tensors require a separately preregistered absolute bound

local_kernel_and_layer0_reference.notes: All conditions required for non-near-zero tensors; maximum-error guard is supplementary, not sufficient alone.

full_model_final_hidden_and_logits_refer.scope: per input, per decode step; all layer checkpoints are recorded but are not assigned the isolated-kernel 1% cap

accuracy.non_numeric_invariants: Zero tolerated errors in opcode/operand decoding, addresses, packing invertibility, bounds, KV indices/lengths, bank ownership, completion count/tag/bank/error, chunk state, and writes outside destinations; no unexpected nonfinite values.
accuracy.change_task_equivalence: All three tasks preserve operand bits and per-output K arithmetic order. Final BF16 outputs, untouched bank data and DDR/KV bytes must match qualified baseline bit-for-bit. Cycle counts may differ. Representation fields are decoded to semantic quantities before trace comparison.
accuracy.ranking: Report top1, top5 overlap and reference top1-top2 margin; top1 mismatch is not waived as quality-equivalent. A reference gap greater than twice the max absolute logit error implies a stable top1 and therefore requires a match.
accuracy.generation_quality: If claiming preserved language quality, run a fixed teacher-forced held-out corpus and propose relative perplexity degradation <=5%; not yet evaluated, distinct from hardware execution correctness.

existing_evidence.scope: first-layer output only; does not qualify full 30-layer or cached continuous decode

baseline_qualification.decode: 16 teacher-forced consecutive steps using identical reference token IDs; exact same inputs on all compared paths. Free-running generation is a separate quality test.
comparisons: HF reference vs semantic ISA interpreter
one-shot vs command-chunked execution with identical arithmetic order
baseline_qualification.tensor_coverage: full channels for selected layers 0,14,29, final normalization and all 49152 logits; full layer-local diagnostic cases; cache append and prior-entry preservation at every decode step
baseline_qualification.chunk_boundaries: at least two legal chunk partitions for identical commands; END drains before next load; no implicit bank/KV reset
baseline_qualification.context_1024: software/address-bound tests at positions 991,992,1023; only claim numerical/board 1024 support after a separate full numerical/board run
baseline_qualification.qualification_policy: Apply proposed thresholds to development inputs, then preregister and freeze before comparison runs. If baseline fails, repair it or explicitly narrow the supported scope. Do not loosen limits after seeing comparison outcomes.
baseline_qualification.semantic_evidence: semantic_baseline_summary.json; software semantic scope only, not FPGA arithmetic qualification

conditions.general_agent: baseline, model/ISA contracts, interpreter, requirements, tools and public pass criteria; free workflow, voluntary contract/interpreter use allowed
conditions.llm2rtl: same resources plus explicit contract review -> lowering/interpreter check -> module verification -> cumulative integration procedure

controls.model_and_reasoning: must be pinned identically before trials
controls.budget: same time/token/API limits for both; determine from pilot and freeze before main trials
controls.independence: fresh immutable baseline copy and new agent context for every run; no patches/logs from previous trials
controls.interventions: Primary endpoint: no post-start human design guidance, bug diagnosis, source edits, repeated proceed prompts or evaluator explanation. Agent may use public tests and raw automated tool errors. Clarifications require no new technical facts beyond fixed initial materials; unresolved specification questions are recorded and the agent chooses an explicit assumption. Infrastructure permission events are recorded separately. A human rescue changes the run to assisted; autonomous outcome stays FAIL.
controls.timing: record wall time, model processing, tool execution and queue/environment wait separately; no successful-run-only averages
controls.continuation: Automatic evaluator feedback and predetermined continuation are allowed equally in both conditions. Never supply evaluator-owned hidden vectors/golden or solution-specific hints. Hidden tests run only after participant completion or budget exhaustion.

design.pilot: one run per task/condition =6, excluded from main results; evaluator fixes allowed only before freeze
design.main: 3 tasks x 2 conditions x 3 repeats =18 independent runs; all failures included
design.ablation: remove interpreter pre-RTL check only, keep final evaluator/interpreter/gates and all other rules; preregister task/repeat count separately
design.primary_endpoint: Unassisted all-gates completion within fixed budget.
design.rescue: Optional separate recovery evaluation after autonomous endpoint recorded; preserve original autonomous failure and measure expert guidance/direct edits/active minutes separately.
